actions: Oct 7: daily budget on the free tour campaign raised from $25 to $32.
Oct 7: a new ad set was created for the area within 10 miles of the club in Lombard.
Oct 7: two free tour ads, Control Ad 1 and Control Ad 2, were added to it. Both passed Meta's review and started delivering the same day.

campaigns.campaign_name: GCAC |Free Tour| On FB Lead Gen Campaign

insights.creative: The first free tour ad brought 20 of the 22 leads Meta counted, at $8.51 each. It opens 'Lombard families have been walking through our doors for over 40 years. Come see why,' lists two heated pools, eight racquetball courts, group fitness, whirlpool and sauna, and offers one free tour: 'No membership required. Nothing to sign.' The two ads added on Oct 7 use the same words. Worth trying one that opens with 'No membership required. Nothing to sign,' since all three ads now say the same thing.
insights.doing: The free tour campaign brought 18 leads into the CRM, the same as the week before. Cost per lead rose to $10.41 from $9.13, with ad spend up to $187.39 from $164.35.
insights.look_into: Meta counted 22 leads and the CRM shows 18, a gap of 4 that is worth checking. The first free tour ad brought 20 of Meta's 22 leads, and the two free tour ads added on Oct 7 have had only two days to run.
insights.next: We recommend leaving the two new free tour ads and the budget unchanged for one full week, then comparing lead count and cost per lead against this week before changing anything else.
